board.accepted_home: T-{id} accepted — the result goes into the squad folder
board.ask_cancel: Cancel T-{id}? The member stops; the branch stays.

board.ask_resume: T-{id} goes back to its member — anything you write about what you did goes with it

board.detail_waiting: Set down — waiting for my part to be done
board.diff_none: No lines differ from the base branch
board.empty: The board is empty. Tell the PM what you want to build and the work shows up here.
board.empty_focus: Nothing on the board for {focus} — ⌘0 shows all projects.
board.empty_query: No tickets match “{q}”. Esc clears it.
board.more_rows: … {more} more · E shows all · find finished work with F
board.pick_ticket: Pick a ticket to see it here
board.resumed: T-{id} goes back to its member
board.stays_on_branch: T-{ticket} stays on its branch — Merge into main from the board whenever you like
browser.no_tabs: No tabs yet — members' browsers show here when they use them, and + opens a tab of your own
browser.status_idle: The same Chrome and sign-ins the members use
browser.status_mine: Your tab · the same sign-ins as the members
browser.status_mine_hand: You're driving — the member's browser tools wait
chat.hint_waiting: Waiting on you · when your part is done, /resume T-{id}
chat.hint_working: What you write here, the working member reads at its next step
chat.member_text: The PM hears about what you tell this member. It takes work from the board and does it in its own folder.
chat.member_title: You can talk to this member directly
chat.memo_note: Memo · read when this turn ends
chat.no_member_text: Run `equipe` in a terminal to start a squad.
chat.no_member_title: No member to talk to yet
chat.pm_build_title: Tell the PM what you want to build
chat.pm_project_text: It goes to the {project} thread you're looking at. The PM answers quick things right away; work becomes tickets on the left.
chat.pm_text: The PM answers quick things right away; work becomes tickets on the left. Open a ticket to watch its work and give directions.
chat.steering_note: Steering · read at the next step, without stopping the work

commands.about_export: Open the conversation in your editor

commands.about_mode: How much members do on their own

commands.about_project: Filter to one project — board, reviews and new work; all takes it off
commands.about_reopen: Send work back with what to change
commands.about_resume: You did what a waiting ticket needed: it goes back to its member
commands.about_scale: Extra members a role may get when its work waits
commands.about_send_apps: Apps where a member's send waits for your yes
commands.about_squad: Switch, start, or change what a squad works on
commands.about_tidy: Ask the PM to look the board over and propose what to close, merge or keep
commands.about_usage: Plan limits, each member's context and tokens
commands.desktop_resume: members may use the screen again
commands.home_changes: what changed in the squad's folder lately
commands.memory_changes: what changed in the squad's memory lately
commands.mode_member_own: just this member · on {mode} of its own
commands.mode_member_squad: just this member · on the squad's {mode}

compose.accepted_merge: T-{ticket} accepted · to merge into main, /merge T-{ticket}
compose.answers_alongside: {name} answers right away, alongside the work in progress
compose.browser_usage: /browser show|hide [member] — for sign-ins and limits, use /browser in the terminal
compose.desktop_resumed: Members can use the screen again
compose.desktop_stopped: Took the screen back: members can't click or type until /desktop resume
compose.help: Type / in the message box for commands, @ for members
compose.member_gone: {name} is no longer in the squad
compose.memo_left: Left {name} a memo — read when this turn ends
compose.merging: Merging T-{ticket} into main (to push too, /merge T-n push)…
compose.merging_push: Merging T-{ticket} into main (and pushing to origin)…
compose.mode_plan: The read-only mode is called read-only: /mode read-only
compose.mode_usage: Modes: {modes} · /mode <mode> for the whole squad, /mode <member> <mode> for one member
compose.model_set: {name} works with {wanted} from the next turn
compose.no_member_in_squad: The squad has no member called {name}
compose.no_member_mention: The squad has no member called @{name}
compose.no_member_yet: No member to talk to yet
compose.no_pm: The squad has no PM to ask
compose.not_in_desktop: /{other} isn't in the desktop app yet — use it in equipe in the terminal
compose.reopen_needs_note: What should change in T-{ticket}? Write it after /reopen T-{ticket} — the member works from that
compose.scale_off: No extra members: each role's work waits for that role's member
compose.scale_set: When work piles up, up to {extra} more per role
compose.scale_usage: /scale <0-6> · /scale off — how many extra members equipe brings in when one role's work piles up
compose.steered: {name} reads it at the next step without stopping the work · send with Tab for a memo read afterwards
composer.inbox_attached: Attached the images sent from the Mac
composer.too_many_images: You can attach up to {n} images at a time
composer.uploading_wait: Uploading images — it sends once they're done
connect.host_key_text: The fingerprint of {host} is below. Connect only if it matches one you got from the machine's administrator or checked on the machine yourself.
connect.intro: Pick the machine where the equipe daemon runs. The next launch connects to the last one you picked.
connect.new_machine: A machine seen for the first time
connect.secret_note: What you type goes to SSH and is dropped right away. Nothing is saved.
connect.ssh_first_time: New to SSH? Turn on Remote Login on the machine to connect to (Mac: System Settings → General → Sharing) and install equipe there too. Passwords aren't saved, and a machine seen for the first time connects only after you check its fingerprint.
connect.title: Connect To
daemon.upload_no_answer: The daemon didn't confirm it received the image
failure.app_too_old_step_menu: Update the app from the equipe menu → Check for Updates…
failure.app_too_old_step_site: Or get the latest app from equipe.im
failure.app_too_old_text: The daemon on {name} speaks protocol {daemon} and this app speaks {app}, so this app can't keep up.
failure.auth_step_copy_id: Register the key on that machine — this is the only time it asks for that machine's password
failure.auth_step_keygen: Create a key if you don't have one (skip this if `~/.ssh/id_ed25519` exists)
failure.auth_step_user: Check the user name (you can enter it as `user@host`)
failure.auth_text: The user name or password is wrong, or this Mac's SSH key isn't registered on that machine. Signing in with a key is easiest — no password every time.
failure.closed_text: Reconnecting. It picks up again on its own once the daemon is up or the network is back.
failure.daemon_off_text: Run `equipe` in a terminal to start the daemon. This window connects as soon as it's up.
failure.daemon_too_old_text: The daemon on {name} speaks protocol {daemon}; this app speaks {app}. Update equipe on that machine and it will connect.
failure.daemon_too_old_title: equipe on {name} is older than this app
failure.daemon_unavailable_step: Run `equipe` on that machine yourself and see whether the same message appears
failure.daemon_unavailable_text: equipe is on {name}, but its daemon couldn't be reached or started. The message below says why.
failure.host_key_changed_step_ask: Ask the machine's administrator why the key changed
failure.host_key_changed_step_remove: If it really did change, remove the old key and try again
failure.host_key_changed_text: The key this Mac remembers differs from the one that address presents now. The machine may have been reinstalled or the address may point to another machine — but someone could also be in the middle, so the app won't allow this connection.
failure.host_key_changed_title: The host key of {name} is different
failure.host_key_refused_step_compare: Compare it with the output of `ssh-keygen -lf /etc/ssh/ssh_host_ed25519_key.pub` on that machine
failure.host_key_refused_step_retry: Press Try Again to see the fingerprint again
failure.host_key_refused_text: This Mac hasn't seen {name} before. It connects only after you confirm the fingerprint belongs to that machine.
failure.host_key_strict_step_ssh: Connect once from a terminal with the command below to check and add the fingerprint
failure.host_key_strict_text: ~/.ssh/config sets `StrictHostKeyChecking yes`, so the key of {name} isn't added automatically.
failure.login_off_step_linux: Linux: install and start an SSH server — the command below is for Debian/Ubuntu (for other distributions, look up how to enable sshd)
failure.login_off_step_mac: Mac: System Settings → General → Sharing → turn on Remote Login (macOS 12 and earlier: System Preferences → Sharing). Check which users are allowed in, too
failure.login_off_step_port: If you changed the port, enter it again as `host:port`
failure.login_off_text: {name} isn't accepting SSH connections — most likely Remote Login (the SSH server) is off on that machine. Turning it on once, at the machine, is enough.
failure.no_bridge_text: equipe on {name} lacks `equipe attach`, which this app uses. Update equipe on that machine and it will connect.
failure.no_equipe_step_install: Install equipe with the line below (with Homebrew: `brew install equipe-labs/tap/equipe`)
failure.no_equipe_step_ssh: Sign in to that machine from a terminal
failure.no_equipe_step_wait: Once it's installed, this window reconnects on its own (`~/.local/bin`, `~/.cargo/bin` and Homebrew folders are found automatically)
failure.no_equipe_text: Couldn't find the `equipe` command on {name}. This app is a window onto that machine's equipe daemon, so equipe must be installed there too.
failure.no_squads_remote_step_run: Go to a project folder and run `equipe`
failure.no_squads_remote_step_ssh: In a terminal, sign in to that machine with the first line below
failure.no_squads_remote_step_wait: Once there is a squad, this window connects on its own
failure.no_squads_remote_text: The daemon on {name} has no squads. Run equipe once in a project folder on that machine to create one.
failure.no_squads_text: Run `equipe` once in a project folder to create a squad. This window will then connect on its own.
failure.other_text: The exact cause is unknown. Check the message below. Connecting to the same host from a terminal shows more detail.
failure.sign_in_cancelled_text: Signing in to {name} takes a password or a verification code. The password isn't saved; SSH keeps it only while the connection lasts.
failure.step_retry_below: When done, press Try Again below
failure.step_retry_when_ready: Press Try Again when you're ready
failure.unreachable_step_awake: Make sure the machine is on and not asleep
failure.unreachable_step_name: Check the name or address (typos; `.local` names are only visible on the same Wi-Fi)
failure.unreachable_step_ssh: Check that `ssh` to the same host works from a terminal
failure.unreachable_step_vpn: If it's on another network, you need a private network such as a VPN or Tailscale
failure.unreachable_text: Couldn't connect to {name}. The name or address may be wrong, the machine may be off (or asleep), or it may be on another network.
failure.update_remote_step: Update on that machine and restart the daemon — working members pause briefly, then carry on
main.banner_reconnecting: Reconnecting — picks up on its own once it's back
main.install_text: This app is a window onto the equipe daemon. Paste the line below into a terminal to install equipe, then run `equipe`. Once the daemon is up, this window connects on its own.
main.remote_daemon_started: Just started the remote daemon — run `equipe daemon install` once on that machine to keep it always on
main.update_on_quit: The update installs when you quit the app
notify.send_waits: · sending waits for a person's permission
notify.stale_daemon: The daemon runs an older version ({version}) — restart it with `equipe daemon restart` while members are idle
notify.waiting_body: {by}Something only a person can do is left
relaunch.label: Restart to Update · {version}
state.review_flash: T-{id} awaits review · /accept T-{id} or /reopen T-{id} <what to change>
state.waiting_flash: T-{id}: waiting on you — {needs} · when done, /resume T-{id}
target.bad_chars: The host or user name has characters that aren't allowed
target.bad_port: The port must be a number from 1 to 65535
target.user_empty: The user name before @ is empty
